title: Independent audit of version-consistent derived market dynamics
objective: Independently verify that daily change and seven-day relative water level are display-only, use only complete comparable persisted observations, preserve insufficient-history states, and do not trigger external operations.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate reporting. This audit is read-only except for its report; no Dune execution, database write, CardKit send, or Feishu operation is authorized.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify production code, tests, migrations, query definitions, task specs other than this audit task, or runtime configuration.
Do not execute Dune queries, PostgreSQL writes, migrations, CardKit sends, Hermes, lark-cli, external providers, backfills, or chain adapters.
Do not read, print, persist, or commit Dune keys, Lark tokens, DATABASE_URL, chat IDs, target lookup responses, cookies, or raw provider payloads.
Do not approve comparisons across query_version, query_ref, source, subject, chain, registry_version, coverage_status, unit, or completeness boundaries.
Do not approve a missing prior day or fewer than seven prior complete UTC days as a zero-valued baseline.
Do not add or approve trading, recommendation, score, buy/sell, Four.meme, full Robinhood, FDV/market-cap, TVL, smart money, Kline, BSC/Robinhood adapter, or chain execution claims.
